nodes.label: Worker (Node.js/TypeScript Orchestrator)
nodes.rationale: Node owns everything stateful and scheduled (auth, delta walking, jobs, chunking, embedding calls, sparse encoding, Qdrant writes) because BullMQ is Node-first; it never parses document formats.

nodes.label: Redis
nodes.rationale: Holds BullMQ queues and sync state; hard requirements: maxmemory-policy noeviction (BullMQ corrupts under eviction) + AOF; fully rebuildable, never long-term truth.

nodes.label: BullMQ
nodes.rationale: Provides Job Schedulers (cron), retries/backoff, manual rate limiting, deduplication, live concurrency — all built in; multi-process scale-out is a deploy change, not a code change.

nodes.label: MSAL Node
nodes.rationale: @azure/msal-node: acquireTokenByDeviceCode for bootstrap, acquireTokenSilent at runtime, pluggable ICachePlugin for the encrypted persistent cache.

nodes.label: Entra App Registration
nodes.rationale: Public client (no secret, no redirect URI, public client flows enabled) — possession of the encrypted token cache is the effective credential; least-privilege delegated scopes Files.Read + offline_access + User.Read.

nodes.label: sync Queue
nodes.rationale: Concurrency 1 is a correctness invariant, not a tuning knob: delta walks must never overlap; manual triggers simply queue behind a running walk.

nodes.label: files Queue
nodes.rationale: Fan-out: process-file, delete-file/folder, update-metadata, refresh-catalog; deduplicated, independently rate-limited and retried; concurrency N default 4, live-adjustable.

nodes.label: BullMQ Job Scheduler
nodes.rationale: upsertJobScheduler is idempotent by scheduler ID — safe on every startup; drives delta-sync cron (default */5) and weekly reconcile.

nodes.label: Redis Sync State (vs:* keys)
nodes.rationale: deltaLink, root ids, base-folder-to-collection map, folder map, per-file cTag/hash/chunk-count/status; every key documents what losing it costs — all rebuildable from OneDrive + Qdrant payloads (D5: no SQL database).

nodes.label: Graph Delta Query
nodes.rationale: Returns only items changed since the stored deltaLink, recursively over the whole subtree; the first run doubles as initial indexing; exact $select list pins the fields; polling chosen over webhooks for v1 (D9).

nodes.label: Delta Item Classification
nodes.rationale: Maps each delta item (deleted/folder/file facets, cTag comparison, base-folder resolution via the vs:folder map) to the right job: process, re-route, metadata patch, delete, or skip; edge cases parked for the Phase-1 spike.

nodes.label: 410 Gone Resync
nodes.rationale: Expired delta token: follow the Location header to a fresh enumeration, classify normally (hash-skip keeps it cheap), reconcile deletions, store the new token — the same code path as manual full resync: one implementation, two triggers.

nodes.label: Delegated Auth (Silent Refresh)
nodes.rationale: Hard user constraint: act as the signed-in user, never app-only/admin consent; interactive once then silent forever; interaction_required is a first-class alert state (health flips, runbook message) — never a crash loop.

nodes.label: Device Code Flow Bootstrap
nodes.rationale: One-time yarn auth CLI prints URL + code; simpler headless than an auth-code/PKCE redirect listener (D2).

nodes.label: Encrypted MSAL Token Cache
nodes.rationale: Custom ~40-line ICachePlugin (AES-256-GCM with MSAL_CACHE_KEY, random IV, atomic tmp+rename write, 0600) because msal-node-extensions targets desktop keychains, not headless containers; lives on a volume so re-auth survives rebuilds.

nodes.label: Change-Notification Webhooks (v2)
nodes.rationale: Deferred: needs a public HTTPS notificationUrl and still requires delta calls (notifications carry no item details) — a latency win only; a notification would just trigger the existing sync job early.

nodes.label: cTag Change Detection
nodes.rationale: cTag changes only when content changes (eTag also churns on metadata); preference order: quickXorHash/sha256 content hashes, then cTag as an opaque equality token.

nodes.label: Job Deduplication (itemId:cTag)
nodes.rationale: Same content version queued once: re-walking an uncommitted delta window collapses silently; a newer cTag is a new dedup ID and the older job completes as superseded after its metadata re-fetch.

nodes.label: Manual Rate Limiting (429 Handling)
nodes.rationale: worker.rateLimit(retryAfter) + Worker.RateLimitError pauses the whole queue without consuming a retry attempt — honors Retry-After from both Graph and DeepInfra; static limiter (max 8 jobs/sec) as safety net.

nodes.label: Runtime-Adjustable Files Concurrency
nodes.rationale: worker.concurrency is a public setter: cli.js concurrency <n> writes a Redis config key, applied live with no restart, reported on /health; the sync worker is deliberately not adjustable — its concurrency 1 is a correctness invariant.

nodes.label: Retry Matrix
nodes.rationale: 429s never consume attempts; transient errors backoff exponentially x4; bad files complete as skipped_* statuses (not errors); auth interaction_required is UnrecoverableError plus red health.

nodes.label: OneDrive as Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: Qdrant and Redis are derived, rebuildable indexes; losing the delta token costs a re-enumeration (hash-skip avoids re-embedding), never data — the principle behind every recovery path.

nodes.label: Idempotency Principle
nodes.rationale: NFR-1: every job safe to run twice, at-least-once delivery end to end — achieved via deterministic point IDs, dedup IDs, delete-then-upsert, and content-hash skips.

nodes.label: At-Least-Once Delivery
nodes.rationale: Delta token advances only after the full page walk and all enqueues (D6); a crash mid-walk re-reads the same window and dedup collapses duplicates; a poison file fails visibly in Bull Board without wedging the token.

nodes.label: Implementation Phases P0-P6
nodes.rationale: P0 bootstrap, P1 auth+graph spike, P2 queues, P3 conversion, P4 indexing (= MVP), P5 hardening, P6 extensions backlog; each phase has acceptance criteria; later plans are written only at phase boundaries because spike findings feed them.

nodes.label: MVP (End of Phase 4)
nodes.rationale: Acceptance = requirements doc section 7: add/edit/delete round-trips, kill-mid-sync safety, base-folder routing and moves, hybrid RRF plus exact-token recall, complete catalog enumeration.

nodes.label: Phase-1 Graph Spike
nodes.rationale: Verifies empirically what docs cannot promise: folder-scoped delta behavior on the real drive type, which file.hashes exist, what move-out-of-scope and folder-rename emit — findings encoded as regression tests and doc updates in 04 section 4.

nodes.label: od_catalog Collection Registry
nodes.rationale: Dense-only by design: routing is semantic while hybrid search happens in document collections. Serves two first-class operations - enumerate (plain scroll, no LLM) and route (semantic query over the embedded name+description). Descriptions regenerate only on material content churn (over 20 percent) to bound LLM cost; updated_at exposes staleness.

nodes.label: conversationId
nodes.rationale: One conversationId names a whole thread, both sides; the app holds only this reference, never turn-level IDs.

nodes.label: app_conversations Collection
nodes.rationale: Owned by the consumer app and outside the managed od_* namespace so nothing vector-syncer does - sync, reconcile, rebuild, base-folder delete - can touch conversations; they survive OneDrive reorganizations and index rebuilds.

nodes.label: appendTurn
nodes.rationale: One small upsert per turn - the rest of the thread is never re-embedded; deterministic uuidv5 point IDs (conv:{conversationId}#{turnIndex}) make retries and edits overwrite instead of duplicate.

nodes.label: Shared Consumer Package (@vector-syncer/consumer)
nodes.rationale: Ships the bm25-v1 encoder and conversation helpers so the consumer app imports the exact modules the indexer uses instead of reimplementing them - prevents tokenizer and encoder drift. Ships in Phase 4.

nodes.label: OpenAI-Compatible Provider Contract
nodes.rationale: The system speaks exactly one API shape through the official OpenAI SDK; DeepInfra is a value, not a dependency - pointing OPENAI_BASE_URL at another provider moves worker and consumer app together. Five env vars are the whole contract; kill switches: empty OCR_LLM_MODEL disables vision, SPARSE_MODE=off forces dense-only writes.

nodes.label: Embedding Model Rebuild Cost
nodes.rationale: Embedding dimensions and semantics are baked into every collection, so changing EMBEDDING_MODEL is a re-index (zero-downtime _v2 build plus alias flip) while every other model or provider swap is a free config flip; finalize the embedding model before the first big backfill. Guarded: every point records embed_model and sparse_encoder, and the worker refuses to start against a mismatched vector size.

nodes.label: Graph Delta Query Polling
nodes.rationale: Cron-polled delta (default every 5 minutes via SYNC_CRON) processes only changed items so quiet polls are nearly free; webhooks deferred. On a sleeping machine syncs are delayed, never lost.

nodes.label: Base Folder to Collection Mapping (od_slug)
nodes.rationale: Each top-level subfolder gets its own collection od_{slug}, with od__root as catch-all. Mapping is keyed by folder ID, not name, so renaming a base folder never renames or rebuilds its collection; the catalog carries the current display name.

nodes.label: Weekly Reconcile
nodes.rationale: Re-checks everything end-to-end as the correctness backstop for any delta edge case missed live.

nodes.label: OneDrive as Single Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: Qdrant is a derived, rebuildable index; deletion in OneDrive always means deletion in Qdrant, and worst-case recovery from any data loss is one full resync - which is why Qdrant snapshots and Redis AOF backups are optional conveniences.
nodes.norm_label: onedrive as single source of truth

nodes.label: /health Endpoint
nodes.rationale: Wire to an uptime monitor on day one because the worst failure mode - a dead refresh token - is otherwise silent. Alert on auth not valid, stale lastSyncAt, climbing failed jobs, jumping ocr_images_processed (cost signal), climbing empty_conversion (unreadable documents).

nodes.label: Manual Sync Trigger
nodes.rationale: Always safe: the sync queue runs at concurrency 1 as a correctness invariant (deliberately not a knob), so a manual trigger queues behind any running walk and runs never overlap.

nodes.label: Live Files-Worker Concurrency
nodes.rationale: Runtime setting with no restart; baseline from FILE_CONCURRENCY, live overrides last until restart.

nodes.label: Resync and Rebuild Commands
nodes.rationale: Plain resync is cheap because hash-skip avoids re-embedding; resync --rebuild builds a _v2 collection and flips the alias for zero-downtime embedding-model, chunking, or OCR redo; resync --catalog refreshes catalog stats and descriptions on demand.

nodes.label: AUTH_REQUIRED Health State
nodes.rationale: Auth death halts loudly instead of crash-looping; recovery is a roughly 2-minute device-code re-login with all state intact and queued work resuming immediately.

nodes.label: Search Result Payload Contract
nodes.rationale: Every point carries everything needed to render a result - text, heading_path breadcrumb, file identity, web_url click-through, attribution - so no second lookup is ever required. Indexed filters: file_id, extension, mime_type, ancestor_ids, last_modified_ts.

nodes.label: Catalog-First Routing
nodes.rationale: Qdrant has no server-side cross-collection query, so ask the catalog which 1-3 collections fit the query, search those, and merge client-side; full fan-out over all collections stays acceptable only because the catalog keeps it rare.

nodes.label: Sparse-Only Degraded Mode
nodes.rationale: Dense query embedding needs the AI provider but sparse encoding is computed locally, so falling back to sparse-only keeps keyword search working through a provider outage.

nodes.label: AES-256-GCM Cache Codec
nodes.rationale: Blob layout iv(12) | authTag(16) | ciphertext; random IV per call; throws on tamper or wrong key.

nodes.label: encryptedCachePlugin
nodes.rationale: Corrupt or unreadable cache warns and starts empty instead of throwing - the empty cache naturally forces the AuthRequiredError path later; cache file written mode 0600.

nodes.label: getGraphToken
nodes.rationale: Typed against a structural TokenApp subset of PublicClientApplication so token acquisition is testable without mocking the msal module; maps InteractionRequiredAuthError to AuthRequiredError and lets unexpected errors escape unchanged.

nodes.label: graphGet Client Wrapper
nodes.rationale: SDK client factory plus typed error mapping: 429 to RateLimitedError with retry-after ms, 410 to DeltaGoneError, everything else passes through.

nodes.label: DeltaGoneError
nodes.rationale: 410 Gone on delta means the token expired - restart enumeration with a fresh folder delta URL, never crash-loop.

nodes.label: resolveRoot
nodes.rationale: Resolves ONEDRIVE_FOLDER_PATH to driveId+folderId via Graph path addressing; the injected-get-function seam is the test strategy for everything Graph-facing.

nodes.label: walkDelta
nodes.rationale: Follows @odata.nextLink pages, invokes onPage per page, returns the final @odata.deltaLink; errors including DeltaGoneError propagate to the caller which owns restart policy.

nodes.label: classifyPage
nodes.rationale: Pure classifier from delta items to typed actions; folders are upserted before files within a page because delta pages can interleave; base folder resolution walks the parent chain with cycle guard and a fetchItem fallback; unresolvable ancestry is counted and skipped, never crashing.

nodes.label: devDelta CLI (yarn dev:delta)
nodes.rationale: The P1 deliverable: classified change listing with persistent deltaLink and 410 restart; P2's sync job reuses exactly this walk-classify-act composition, swapping print for enqueue.

nodes.label: Converter /healthz Endpoint
nodes.rationale: FastAPI skeleton reporting ocr_tier (none, llm, or docintel) from env; POST /convert arrives in the P3 plan on this same app.

nodes.label: Phase-1 Delta Spike
nodes.rationale: Move-out-of-scope and folder-rename delta behavior are assumptions until verified on the real tenant; findings are written into the Graph integration doc and pinned as classifier regression tests, and the P2 plan is written only after this lands.
